The nibble is `wireVersion & 0x0F`, so it **wraps after 16 bumps** — a receiver MUST NOT treat a nibble match as compatibility, only as \"worth parsing the beacon\". |\n1271-| **Wire compatibility** | The beacon's `wireVersion` gates the wire format. A receiver seeing an unknown version MUST report `E-VERSION` with both versions shown and refuse — **never attempt a partial parse**. |\n1272-| **What is breaking** | Any change to header layout, beacon layout, PRNG, degree distribution, or fragment semantics. Bump `magic_ver`. |\n1273-| **What is not** | UI, coaching, profile ladder tuning, dwell, new *optional* beacon fields appended at the end. |\n1274-| **Stage coexistence** | Stage 1/2/3 modulations are distinguished by the beacon's `flags`, not by `magic_ver` — a Stage-1-only receiver MUST ignore colour tiles rather than fail. |\n1275-| **Rollback consequence** | Rolling the sender back may strand receivers holding a newer cached build. deviceContext?: DeviceContext\n): BeaconMeta {\n  let offset = 0;\n\n  const readU32 = (): number => {\n    const value = (bytes[offset]! << 24) |\n                 (bytes[offset + 1]! << 16) |\n                 (bytes[offset + 2]! << 8) |\n                 bytes[offset + 3]!;\n    offset += 4;\n    return value >>> 0; // Force unsigned\n  };\n\n  const readU24 = (): number => {\n    const value = (bytes[offset]! << 16) |\n                 (bytes[offset + 1]! << 8) |\n                 bytes[offset + 2]!;\n    offset += 3;\n    return value >>> 0;\n  };\n\n  const readU16 = (): number => {\n    const value = (bytes[offset]! << 8) | bytes[offset + 1]!;\n    offset += 2;\n    return value >>> 0;\n  };\n\n  const readU8 = (): number => {\n    const value = bytes[offset]!;\n    offset += 1;\n    return value;\n  };\n\n  const readBytes = (n: number): Uint8Array => {\n    const value = bytes.subarray(offset, offset + n);\n    offset += n;\n    return value;\n  };\n\n  const readString = expected ${expectedSize} (body+CRC)`,\n      {actual: bytes.length, expected: expectedSize}\n    );\n  }\n\n  // Read the CRC-32 from the last 4 bytes\n  const storedCrc = ((bytes[offset]! << 24) |\n                    (bytes[offset + 1]! << 16) |\n                    (bytes[offset + 2]! << 8) |\n                    bytes[offset + 3]!) >>> 0; // Force unsigned\n\n  // Calculate CRC-32 over the {originalSize, max: BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE}\n    );\n  }\n\n  // T1: originalSize must fit in available quota\n  if (originalSize > availableQuota) {\n    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n      'E-QUOTA-PREFLIGHT',\n      `Original size (${originalSize}) exceeds available quota (${availableQuota})`,\n      {originalSize, availableQuota}\n    );\n  }\n\n  // T1: payloadLen bounds check (same limit as originalSize)\n  if (payloadLen > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_FILE_SIZE) {\n    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n      `Declared payload length (${payloadLen}) exceeds maximum BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_BLOCK_COUNT}\n    );\n  }\n\n  // T1: K_manifest bounds check (bf-5fs)\n  // K_manifest is the number of blocks needed to store the block hash manifest.\n  // Unbounded K_manifest is a DoS vector: with MAX_BLOCK_COUNT (16.7M) and blockHashLen=4,\n  // the manifest would be 262,144 fragments and ~8.6 GB of matrix data.\n  const blockCountManifest = calculateKManifest(blockCount, blockHashLen);\n  if (blockCountManifest > BEACON_LIMITS.MAX_K_MANIFEST_BLOCKS) {\n    throw new BeaconValidationError(\n      'E-META-BOUNDS',\n      `Manifest block count (${blockCountManifest})
